notes: Ashfall, an invented live-fire restaurant in Johannesburg. Single index.html with 34-item menu (search, category and dietary filters), reservation flow with computed slots and confirmation, persistent basket and collection orders, open-now status with special hours, mobile nav, canvas ember field that reacts to pointer and press-and-hold, optional Web Audio fire sound, SVG wordmark and procedurally drawn dishes. Built under a compact size budget so scope is lean; JavaScript syntax-checked with node but not run in a real browser.
